messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT S2 — multiple GPU/PCI errors detected in dedicated pool 'pegasus-enterprise' (VPC acme-prod). Node node-7 (gpu-7) in us-west-2a showing ECC spikes and BMC reboots. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/4054321000

maria (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging SRE. Impact?

jake (sre): I'm on it — checking metrics and current allocations. Seen a sustained ECC counter increase and a BMC power-cycle at 03:42 UTC. Customer requests low-RTO, they're on dedicated reserved capacity.

acme-platform: We have ~8 active hosts on that node, 3 are acme-prod critical jobs.

maria (oncall): Priorities: isolate node, drain workloads for affected tenants (acme-prod first), and failover to reserve capacity. Notify account.

rachel (acct): Noted — I'll message AM and let ACME support know we may schedule a rolling migration. Keep me posted for any customer-visible errors.

jake (sre): Proposed immediate steps: 1) Set node to quarantine 2) Start graceful drain 3) Route new allocations away 4) Kick migration to reserved pool. Anyone object?

sam (hw): Paging hardware team for on-site RMA prep. BMC logs suggest repeated firmware reset; might be flaky PSU or BMC watchdog.

maria (oncall): Execute drain now. Use runbook snippet: ```rictl node set-quarantine --node node-7 --reason "ECC spike/BMC reboot"``` ```rictl node drain --node node-7 --mode graceful --timeout 10m``` Also run health-copy for acme-prod sessions.

infra-ops: Running quarantine command... Done. Node marked quarantine.

ops-bot: Drain initiated by maria (oncall) for node-7. Live progress: 0/8 tasks moved.

jake (sre): Kicking migration for acme-prod critical jobs to reserved pool 'pegasus-reserve-a'. Command: ```rictl migration start --from node-7 --to pool pegasus-reserve-a --tenants acme-prod --priority high```

acme-platform: Confirmed migration start. We'll pause non-critical batch jobs to speed live migration.

ops-bot: Migration progress: 3/8 tasks moved. No task errors so far.

sam (hw): Can we capture GPU ECC logs and core dumps before full power cycle? Need for RCA. If drain completes, hold node offline and attach serial logs.

maria (oncall): Good call. Jake, can you snapshot /var/log/gpu* and upload to ticket?

jake (sre): Done — uploaded to incident ticket IR-4054321000. Also captured dmesg and BMC journal.

ops-bot: Migration progress: 7/8 tasks moved. One long-running session remains (acme-prod, session id s-9876).

acme-platform: That session is a training job with checkpointing; we can coordinate warm-swap to avoid restarting.

maria (oncall): Reach out to ACME contact to agree brief checkpoint pause. Rachel?

rachel (acct): Messaging them now. ETA response 2-3 mins.

acme-platform: ACME approved 90s soft pause. Proceeding to move final task.

ops-bot: Migration progress: 8/8 tasks moved. Drain complete. Node-7 now empty and offline.

jake (sre): Node successfully drained. Switched routing away from us-west-2a for that host. Temporary capacity from pegasus-reserve-a picked up 12% of traffic. No 5xx customer errors reported.

sam (hw): Please leave node powered but isolated. We'll pull serial after 10m stabilization to collect BMC flash and check PSU voltages. I've started an RMA request for PSU/MB.

maria (oncall): Filing customer-impact summary: ACME dedicated VPC had potential impact window 03:42–03:47 UTC; finalized with zero restarts and no user-facing errors due to successful warm-swap. Rachel to follow up w/ACME for postmortem and RMA timeline.

rachel (acct): I'll open an incident update to ACME and copy SRE notes + RCA artifacts.

jake (sre): Followups: 1) Run full hardware diag once RMA part arrives 2) Update firmware on BMC if confirmed flaky 3) Add auto-quarantine threshold to avoid requeueing the same node 4) Postmortem in #postmortems with timeline and logs.

sam (hw): Agree. Also recommend adding temporary sensor alert for PSU voltage jitter on that rack.

maria (oncall): Assigning handoff: Sam takes hardware lead (RMA/diag), Jake owns remediation + postmortem, Rachel owns customer comms. If node flaps again, escalation to SEV1.

incident-bot: Incident IR-4054321000 created and linked: https://incidents.redwood.internal/IR-4054321000 — Severity S2, status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria (oncall): Closing on-call actions, switching to monitoring. If any regression in 30m, re-open and page. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
